_comment: Zenith hydrostatic delay at each fixture column's own surface, in metres.
production_zhd_m: what OPERA L4 TROPO-ZENITH ships today, produced with the
RAiDER release it pins (v0.5.3). It carries the calcgeoh half-level defect.
This file is NOT an assertion. It exists so RAiDER CI can report how far a
change moves an operational downstream product. The pass/fail decision on
that delta belongs to opera-adt/tropo, which owns the product and the
reprocessing budget -- not to a RAiDER reviewer who has no way to judge it.
